verdict.rationale: The public GitHub repository Expensify/App includes build-from-source instructions (`npm install`, `npm run web`), so the app's source is publicly readable. Nothing in the evidence names the license or shows it is an open one. It is also unclear whether this repo covers the whole product or only the client app. Missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license, clarity on which parts of the product (backend vs. client) are published, independent corroboration.
